notes: Shaded rendering of real LRO NAC DTM elevation (not a photo). Crop is a 2.4km square placed to minimize nodata while containing the DTM's highest well-supported pixel (>=60m from any stereo-correlation gap), resampled from 2 m/px native to 1024x1024 (2.34 m/px in this crop). Spawn (158,866) and goal (114,792) were relocated from the initial site-picker picks by tools/patch_playability_sites.py: the original spawn (214,633) sat in a slope-isolated pocket unreachable from most of the map under a realistic guardrail, and the original goal (128,793, the true highest pixel) is only reachable from a safe spawn via a knife-edge terrain pinch that a delayed-telemetry controller can't reliably clear. The current goal (114,792, elev -990.0m) is 8m below the original summit pixel - functionally the same peak - reached by a route with a real safety margin on every step, verified end to end by tests/playability.test.mjs. mask.bin marks nodata-filled cells (rendered as a hatched no-data texture in albedo.jpg/preview.png); spawn and goal are kept >= 20px clear of them.
maskMeaning: 1 = no orbital data (filled), treat as impassable
